title: Siargao vs Bohol: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Siargao for surf culture, island hopping, and a laid-back international vibe. Bohol for Chocolate Hills, tarsiers, and Balicasag diving. Surfers go to Siargao; sightseers go to Bohol.

categories.name: Surf & Water Sports
categories.summary: Cloud 9 is a world-class right-hand reef break. Bohol has no surf scene.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Siargao has great island-hopping beaches. Bohol has excellent Panglao and Anda beaches.

categories.name: Diving & Marine Life
categories.summary: Balicasag Island wall diving and whale sharks. Siargao has Sohoton Cove but is not a dive destination.

categories.name: Wildlife & Sightseeing
categories.summary: Chocolate Hills and tarsiers are unique to Bohol. Siargao has tidal pools and lagoons.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: PHP 1,500-3,000/day for Siargao vs PHP 2,000-3,500/day for Bohol.

categories.name: Nightlife & Vibe
categories.summary: General Luna has a more international and diverse nightlife scene.

categories.name: Family-Friendliness
categories.summary: Bohol is better for families with its structured sightseeing and calm waters.

faq.question: Is Siargao or Bohol better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Bohol is better for first-timers who want iconic sights and easy logistics from Cebu. Siargao is better for those who want surf culture and island life.

faq.question: Can I do both on one trip?
faq.answer: Yes — fly to Cebu, ferry to Bohol, then fly Cebu-Siargao. Allow 4-5 days minimum per destination.
